newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-NORTHERN IRELAND FRUSTRATE GERMANS IN 1-1 DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORTHERN IRELAND FRUSTRATE GERMANS IN 1-1 DRAW.

text.p: Northern Ireland frustrated Germany's World Cup qualifying campaign when they held the European champions to a 1-1 draw in a group nine qualifier on Saturday.
Germany, who have now not beaten Northern Ireland in five matches since 1977, had to come back from behind after defender Gerry Taggart gave the visitors a shock lead in the 39th minute.
Midfielder Andy Moeller scored a superb individual goal two minutes later to equalize. But Berti Vogts's team failed to find a way through a well-organised defence.
Northern Ireland 'keeper Tommy Wright, playing his first international for two years, had a superb game. Luck was not on the Germans side at all.
Captain Juergen Klinsmann saw a second-half header hit both posts before bouncing into Wright's arms.
